discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in 202642e: parseStatus now keeps the original path on R/C records (originalPath on the file entry). The webview includes it in unstage actions (unstagePaths helper, used for row, group, and breadcrumb unstage) and passes it to get_git_file_diff so a staged rename reads HEAD at the old path. Covered by a real-repo test that git mv's a file, checks the diff shows the old contents, unstages both paths, and verifies the old path is no longer staged as a deletion.
Fixed in 202642e: numstat records split on the first two tabs only and the remainder is kept as the filename, with a test for a tab-containing name.

Fixed in `1544b995b`. `suggestion()` in `candidates.ts` now clips `prompt` to `PROMPT_MAX_CHARS` and `why` to `WHY_MAX_CHARS` before it hashes the id, so rule, model and turn rows all stay inside the published bounds. Text within the limits is unchanged, so the `host-rules.json` parity fixtures keep their ids. `contracts.test.ts` builds rows from a long task title, a status headline and a failing check list, and validates the set and push against `NextTurnSet` and `NextTurnTrayPush`.

Valid, and fixed in 1690c40bf. I removed the cap. Each failure record is what stops its run from falling back to an earlier checkpoint, so failures now persist for the life of the session, as checkpoint history does. Covered by `keeps every failure so no failed run falls back to an earlier checkpoint` in `checkpoint-records.test.ts`; it fails if the cap is put back.

Fair point. Switched to splitting on `path.sep` only (same approach as the SDK's workspace file-indexer), so POSIX filenames containing a literal backslash are left intact. Added a POSIX-only test for that case.
